Slot Balancing only applies in Fair Arena gameplay, where the Ranger's base stats and equipped gear are disabled. Players can manually configure Peacemaker and Set Effects via Slot Balancing. If no preset is configured, the corresponding effects will not activate in the arena.

One-click Sync instantly copies the currently equipped Peacemaker attributes and Set Effects into the Slot Balancing setup. Note that only the current season's Peacemaker and Set Effects are valid, so synchronization is limited to the highest-tier gear available in the current game version.

Once configured, Slot Balancing settings are automatically saved to the player's current loadout. Rangers can navigate to the [Preset Management] interface to save the entire build—including Slot Balancing—as a Battle Prep preset.
